title: tesso config
description: Configuration for the tesso CLI. CSS variables for light and dark themes, plus an optional component registry URL.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL or path. The CLI writes ./node_modules/tesso-ui/schema.json.

tokens.description: Globs for DTCG token JSON files, relative to the app root.

outFile.description: CSS file written by build. Fusor copies it when assets points at its directory.

engine.description: Token engine. MVP ships terrazzo. style-dictionary is reserved.

themeAttribute.description: Kept so existing configs load. Light and dark CSS use :root and .dark. This attribute is only used for themes other than the first and dark.

themes.description: Theme names. The first is :root. A theme named dark is emitted under .dark. There is no prefers-color-scheme block.

prefix.description: Optional CSS variable prefix without leading dashes. Empty emits plain names such as --background. A custom prefix emits --brand-background.

registry.description: Reserved. An http(s) URL returning the same JSON document as the built-in registry. Omit it until remote registries exist.
